summary: Breeze Acquisition Corp. II filed an amended Form 8-K restating the audited balance sheet tied to its initial public offering, which closed May 14, 2026. The company sold 12,500,000 units initially and 1,500,000 more on the underwriters' partial over-allotment exercise May 15, 2026, at $10.00 per unit, raising $140 million gross. A concurrent private placement of 470,000 units to Breeze Sponsor II, LLC raised $4.7 million. Roughly $144.7 million sits in a Continental Stock Transfer trust account. Watch restatement remediation and deal-sourcing clock.
